text: Some of my own practices make their way into these domes.
I stood lookout outside the skin of a ship in the Arctic Circle, for hours at a time, over months.
There is exactly one way to stay warm out there: layers on layers on layers, and then a wind-breaking, watertight suit over all of it.
You end up looking like the Michelin man.
A dome with a removable shell can work the same way.
Lift the shell, add a quilted layer, put the shell back over it.
Quilted recycled fabric is one of the largest waste streams there is.
